title: Meet the new update tour
summary: After a Desktop or Web update, AD Tools now explains what changed and points you to a useful next step.
notes: Desktop notes appear after the update installs successfully.
Web deployments refresh automatically when a new build is detected.
Use Next for follow-up actions, or start the short workspace tour.

slides.title: See the change, then keep moving
slides.body: Each release can include a focused explanation, an optional image, and a link or action into the updated workflow.
bullets: Use one slide for each meaningful change.
Open a guide or use the primary action when you want more detail.

tour.title: Search the workspace
tour.body: Use the search field or press ⌘K to jump to tools, pages, and saved Quick Query schemas.

tour.title: Keep frequent tools close
tour.body: Pin the tools you use most from the sidebar so they stay easy to reach.
